description: Six channel mixer for audio and control voltages, with separate sums of the odd and the even channels, mixed through a saturation stage that compresses levels above the rails instead of clipping them

params.text: Sets how much of the input of the same number goes into the mix, from silence to unity gain

inputs.text: A signal to be mixed, at the level set by the knob of the same number

outputs.text: The sum of all six channels
